precepts.text: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him. So he is not the God of the dead. So that church is the church of the dead, because they worship the dead.
precepts.point: And his chambers by wrong. Was stealing all the gold out of Haiti wrong? Was creating coups in every single country in South America wrong?

note.label: Esau the Hater, Liar, and Killer

precepts.why:
Christ says of his Father: “For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.” So the Most High is not the God of the dead.

That church, with its statues all over the place that the people bow down to, is the church of the dead, because they worship the dead. They pray to dead men and graven images, the dumb idols Habakkuk calls a teacher of lies, and the God of Israel is not in that.

It is the same church that enslaved us and built its house by unrighteousness, the house Jeremiah pronounces woe upon: “Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong”. A people who worship the dead cannot be serving the living God, and that is why a so-called Black Catholic should come out of it. The God of the living is the God of the ones who keep his word, not the God of the statues.

precepts.text: They watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men. Now I'm going to tell you, there's going to be an explosion, a spiritual explosion, an influx of believers, especially from the Christian church. There's going to be 3,000 one day, 5,000 another day; it's going to happen because the scriptures say that. But we got to be mindful: there will be feigned people. During the time of Christ you had a lot of fake brothers amongst them, so we expect that to be true today.
precepts.point: So this is where you self-examine: am I being a phony, a hypocrite amongst the brethren? Am I walking feignedly? Only you can answer that. You and God know the answer; we don't. If a sister ask us, what about this brother, we can only tell her what you show us. Is he really like that? You got to talk to this guy more in depth, more personally, to find out how they truly are. And some brothers can fake it real good.

note.label: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.why:
“Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before thee.” To feign means to pretend, to fake, to give a false show of something. And Luke shows feigning in action: “And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words.” They pretended to be just men so they could catch Christ in his words.

During the time of Christ there were a lot of fake brothers among them, so we expect that to be true today. There is going to be an explosion, a spiritual explosion, an influx of believers, especially from the Christian church: 3,000 one day, 5,000 another day. It's going to happen, because the scriptures say it.

But we have to be mindful: there will be feigned people among them. Ezra asks God not to think upon those, “but remember them, which according to thy will have known thy fear.”

precepts.text: And sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men. Oh, we might have a few of them up in here. We might have a few of them up in our Atlanta congregation, New York congregation, Mississippi congregation. We know you there, biding your time.
precepts.point: And they watched him. Who is the they that watched him? The Pharisees. So they was always looking for accusations against Christ. Following him, following him, seeing is he going to slip up that we might accuse him. Remember what Christ said: if they do it unto you, surely they have done it unto me. They follow you block to block, state to state, camp corner to camp corner; surely they have done it unto Christ.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

precepts.why:
They did not only watch Christ from the outside. “And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.”

Spies pretending to be just men, sitting among his hearers, waiting to take hold of his words and hand him over to the governor.

Oh, we might have a few of them up in here. We might have a few of them up in our Atlanta congregation, New York congregation, Mississippi congregation. We know you're there, biding your time. The Pharisees watched Christ on the sabbath that they might accuse him, and they still send forth spies today, feigning themselves just men.

precepts.text: These filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
precepts.point: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken, but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
In the parable the husbandmen beat the servants the lord of the vineyard sent, entreated them shamefully and sent them away empty, and when the beloved son came they said, “This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.” The servants are the prophets they killed. Jude shows what kind of men do that: “Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.”

Speaking evil of dignities is how you know these are the ones reserved for darkness. Remember what Christ asked them: “The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?” They reasoned, if we say from heaven, he will ask why we did not believe him. They spoke evil of John, and he was a dignity. They spoke evil of Christ, a dignity. They spoke evil of the twelve, dignities.

Peter says the same: “they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.” Not afraid means you are supposed to be afraid; there is a consequence when you do it. When you say Paul was a false prophet, when you say John was a fake Israelite camp, when you disrespect Christ, Moses and the twelve disciples, bad things follow. Darkness falls upon you. Now the nations can be saved, we're not Israelites no more, we're going to wear Israeli fringes and yarmulkes and speak Yiddish: darkness falls upon you for speaking evil of dignities.

So the lord of the vineyard “shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others”, and when they heard it they said, God forbid. They knew he was talking about them.

You know what that is? The SPLC today. The ADL today. So be mindful, brothers, of the things you say and do. The people sitting next to you may be getting paid to listen, to set brothers and sisters up. I remember there was a brother back in New York. He wanted us to buy weapons. We said, bro, you have to go with this stuff. You are not selling weapons to anybody. We have some crazy people among us.

They watched him, and sent forth spies which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words and deliver him to the power of the governor. That is why the camp's YouTube channels stay up: so they can watch.

In France, private conversations among the brothers came out in the court case that expelled a brother, because men came in acting righteous who were sent to set them up. Whatever you say must be scriptural. And those who take that work for a house and a little money condemn their souls for ever.
